verdict.rationale: Convex's own CLI documents `npx convex import`, which loads data from a file into a deployment. That is a first-party bulk-ingest capability an agent or user can invoke. Beyond import, the pack shows only general-purpose primitives: CLI `run` of arbitrary mutations, ACID transactions and MCP tools. These are building blocks a developer could use to write bulk logic, not a documented bulk-operation feature. missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete across many existing documents, batch operations exposed via MCP or HTTP API, limits/scale documentation for bulk writes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
